notes: stocktaking preparation file (ST_STOCK_DEF.fmx): header per store and date (MAST_SERIAL max+1 per store and date, stores allowed for the group) and the scanned lines (ITEM_SERIAL max+1; the code is a lot barcode, a GTIN, an item barcode or an item code; lot by lot number / expiry month; lot price)

rules.where: (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or STORE_CODE in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER and sp.flag = 1))

ST_STOCK_DEF.STORE_CODE.lov: select s.store_code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and nvl(s.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or s.store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by s.store_code

ST_STOCK_DEF_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(i.name_a) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)
